dashboard: version paid-customer preview module load
Align paid-customer intelligence with Administration contract
Project onboarding rules into Data eligibility policy
infrastructure: bridge paid-customer preview and acceptance

gates.evidence: The retained private Dashboard baseline is authenticated and healthy; the paid-customer foundation requires its own exact-artifact deployment before that new behavior is production operational.
Versioned Administration schema, fail-closed validation, deterministic preview, and lifecycle contracts are covered by owner and integration tests.

Server-authority company/workspace binding, non-enumerating denial, exact storage scope, and cross-company adversarial tests pass across Security, Data, CRM, Intelligence, Dashboard, and Infrastructure.
Provisioning plans and retries are deterministic and idempotent, but no real company or workspace is authorized for activation.
Stable internal identifiers, safe singular/plural labels, controlled fallbacks, and unrelated-industry templates pass without customer-specific code branches.
Metric identity and historical label snapshots are immutable across Administration, CRM, Dashboard, and Intelligence projections.
Authorized cities, ZIP codes, territory identities, and travel constraints validate fail closed and remain company/workspace scoped.
Provider refresh and scheduler remain OFF, no provider credential or paid source is authorized, and no quarantined business may move to an active pool.
Verified identity, address, territory, category, operating status, hours, source, freshness, duplicate, exclusion, target-profile, and evidence-quality gates fail closed.
The authenticated read-only configuration preview and paid-customer unconfigured state are reusable, responsive, non-activating, and customer neutral.
Role contracts and authorization are verified, but no paid-customer identity roster, invitation, or activation has been approved.
Configuration projection, role enforcement, idempotent provisioning, metric history, suspension, and offboarding pass with record mutation and notifications disabled.
The public Route IQ website and governed request CRM remain on their accepted public Worker and are outside this private release.
Billing implementation and payment collection are expressly outside this directive.
Existing Worker health monitoring remains available, but paid-customer onboarding incident ownership and operational response have not been exercised for a real customer.
Append-only evidence preservation, write denial, terminal offboarding, and recovery controls pass deterministic tests without destructive deletion.
No real paid customer, representative, provider, business pool, collection path, CRM mutation, or billing flow is authorized by this foundation release.
